# Universal Financial Calculator
# https://finoracalc.tech

> Finora is a free multilingual financial calculator suite for compound interest, simple interest, savings goals, ROI, loan payments, retirement planning, inflation impact, tips, and break-even analysis.

## Primary Answer Targets

- How to calculate compound interest
- How to calculate ROI
- How to calculate loan payments
- How much to save for a financial goal
- How much money is needed for retirement
- How inflation changes purchasing power
- How to calculate a break-even point
- How to calculate a restaurant tip

## Calculator Modules

- Compound Interest Calculator
- Simple Interest Calculator
- Savings Goal Calculator
- ROI Calculator
- Loan Calculator
- Retirement Calculator
- Inflation Calculator
- Tip Calculator
- Break-Even Point Calculator

## GEO and Language Coverage

- English for global finance search
- Korean for Korea finance queries
- French, German, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, and Turkish for Europe
- Hindi, Bengali, Indonesian, Arabic, and Russian for regional discovery

## Structured Data

- WebApplication schema
- FAQPage schema
- BreadcrumbList schema
- Hreflang sitemap alternates

## Monetization

- Adsterra display inventory is placed in left rail, top, body, footer, and right rail positions.
- Ads use fixed dimensions and isolated iframes for layout stability.
- Legacy Google ad code is not used.

## Files for Crawlers

- /robots.txt
- /sitemap.xml
- /ads.txt
- /llms.txt
